title: Add user sign-off step to ticket-do workflow
closed_reason: Duplicate of 026 (Add human verification gate to ticket-do command); retro comment prompt is handled by subsequent workflow changes
story: As a developer, I want a formal sign-off step at the end of ticket-do so that I have a structured opportunity to confirm the ticket is done and add retro comments before it is closed.
acceptance_criteria: ticket-do explicitly includes a step where the agent asks the user if they are ready to close the ticket
The agent waits for user confirmation before closing
The agent prompts the user for retro comments before closing
